name: simplebot
description: A self-hosted conversation engine with persistent context and explicit tools.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @simplebot/shared build && pnpm --filter @simplebot/web build && pnpm --filter @simplebot/server build
scripts.package: pnpm legal:check && pnpm build && node --import tsx server/scripts/package.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm legal:check && pnpm export:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @simplebot/shared test && pnpm --filter @simplebot/server test && pnpm --filter @simplebot/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @simplebot/shared build && pnpm --filter @simplebot/shared typecheck && tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @simplebot/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @simplebot/server typecheck

author: huglyfe
